IAM.purpose: Separate AccountId, PrincipalId and SessionId from network peers and world entities.

AUTHZ.purpose: One deny/allow decision boundary for principal/actor actions on resources.

RF.purpose: Stable reference-frame identity/transforms for bodies, ships, interiors and local physics.

TF.purpose: Simulation-time and domain-tick semantics independent from wall/network/presentation clocks.

SD.purpose: Frame-aware WorldAddress and mappings to domain-specific spatial identities without one universal ChunkId.

MAT.purpose: One MaterialDefinitionId shared by G9, Matter, Item, Construction, fabrication and ENV.

WT.purpose: WorldOperation and WorldTransactionPlan compile cross-domain consequences to existing M0 atomic commits.

WQ.purpose: Actor-scoped query planning across domain adapters without canonical storage ownership.

LIFE.purpose: Common ABSTRACT/DORMANT/SIMULATED/ACTIVE/PRESENTED lifecycle semantics preserving canonical identity.

WB.purpose: Bound work and choose full/coarse/defer/batch/S1-dispatch without owning authority or canonical state.

COMPAT.purpose: Explicit schema/protocol/content/migration versions for a long-lived persistent universe.

SEC.purpose: Trust boundaries, abuse resistance, negative tests, query secrecy and admin audit.

mandatory_intersections.rule: session continuity never redefines actor identity
frame identity never implies authority route
simulation time never becomes work scheduler
one material identity; domain projections remain domain-owned
compile to M0; never create a second transaction engine
human and AI actors converge on the same WorldOperation path

network_continuation: declare current NX/M7 frontier before next acceptance
B1 may be prepared after explicit PC0 declaration

p1_programs.OPS: cluster/world observability, drain, migration, backup and rolling upgrade
